{{Top|leg}}
'''Virtual life-forms''' were a technology distinctive from [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and [[Computer/Legends|computers]].

Refugees of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] in [[Refugee Facility 17]] on [[Ruan]] were educated on how to interface with them in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] to update the varying [[Species/Legends|species']] knowledge for labor use.

General awareness of such technology was increasingly uncommon from the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] toward the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].
